title.en: Dad The Strongest God Of War

description.en: The “God of War” became a thing of the past, and the word “Supreme Lin” was buried, his daughter was bullied, his wife was insulted, and Lin Feng finally woke up from his slumber: I can guard millions of square kilometers of Shenhua's territory, but I can't protect my own family! The supreme being returns, reappearing at the peak!
description.zh: 诸神之战”成为过去,“林至尊”三个字也被埋没,女儿被欺负,妻子被侮辱,林峰忍无可忍,终于从沉睡中醒来:我守得住神华千万平方公里的疆土,还守不住自己的家?!至 尊归来,再现巅峰!

description.en:
When I was ten, I fell from a tree and hit my head. When I woke up, the world around me had changed. I could see people’s emotions in the form of numbers and colours—pink for love, red for anger, green for awkwardness, blue for sorrow, yellow for desire…
I met Yan Kongshan the summer after college entrance exams on Green Plum Island. Mysterious and handsome, with a tinge of melancholy, he was the ideal man of every woman on the island. And mine. I wanted him to turn pink for me, but one day, he suddenly turned yellow. Despite that, he seemed ever so nonchalant when facing me.
Love is like lemon soda water. Sour and sweet, filled with energy. You never know how a person’s heart beats for you, hidden in its cage beneath their flesh.

A teenage boy by the name of Huo Xiao Tang goes investigating the cause of death of his father, along the way, he learns secrets about the family at the ancestral hall from his abandoned old village. While being in that village, he felt strange things that surround him. After reading the book left by his father, he witnesses a world of death!

description.pt-br: Projetando uma estante personalizada para o cara mais gostoso da cidade?! Entrando em sua residência particular à vontade?! Se sua legião de fãs descobrisse isso, eles provavelmente morreriam de ciúmes... nem li livros! Ele só a contratou para ler seus roteiros! Com licença

description.en:
Mo Fei, a seemingly regular high school girl, possesses a special ability to see a 61-minute countdown to a person's death! To her surprise, this ominous countdown appears on her best friend, Ran Guo'er.

While investigating her best friend's supposed "suicide”, she crosses paths with Jiang Yu, a person dedicated to justice, multiple times. The two help each other, and follow the “suicide” case, unaware of the many cases to come…

In order to assassinate the mysterious principal of Superman High School, Jack of Hearts, disguised as Jack Chen, an ordinary human exchange student, infiltrates into the isolated Superman High School. He is accidentally assigned to Class F, the worst class. A group of problematic students with powerful superpowers make our strongest killer Jack of Hearts suffer a lot. Every single day is a frenzy and a life-threatening routine and the plan to assassinate the principal seems to be out of reach.
description.id: Supaya membunuh kepala sekolah dari Sekolah Superman, Jack of Hearts, menyamar sebagai Jack Chen, pertukaran siswa manusia biasa, menyusup ke Sekolah Superman yang tersembunyi. Dia secara kebetulan di masukan ke Kelas F, kelas paling terburuk. Sebuah kelompok siswa bermasalah dengan kekuatan superpower yang membuat pembunuh terkuat kita Jack of Hearts pusing tujuh keliling. Tipa hari penuh dengan kehidupan yang melelahkan dan gila dan rencana untuk membunuh kepala sekolah tampaknya di luar jangkauan.

description.en: One is the commander of the Forbidden Forest Guard, who is famous for his bloody and vicious blood, and is also a short-lived mixed blood with a mysterious bloodline; the other is a waste with a very weak bloodline, and is also the master of anti-imperial forces; when the strong meet, who is who? The catastrophe, who is whose way home? With the body as the chain and the heart as the lock, let you willingly become my prisoner?

description.en:
In just one night, the Nouveau riche, Chen Chen, became broke and miserable. His girlfriend ran off with somebody else, and surprisingly, the culprit behind his tragedy was his own best friend. When Chen Chen almost got hit by a car, a mysterious system suddenly appeared.

“Do you want to take revenge?”

Chen Chen couldn't die in content that way. Since then, he got the Xue Ba system, which helped him take over the world and live without an opponent!

When a dark cloud shrouds over a guy’s life, a Goddess appears! Will she be able to fulfill all of his wishes?

Silver Award in the Yaoqi Village 2024 Contest (Short Comic)

description.en: Young Lu Yu traverses to a different world and acquires the "No Rush, Take Your Time Lottery System." In this new world, peculiar gods, buddhas, and demons are worshipped everywhere, giving rise to various sects. The followers fervently desire their deities to descend and either rule or destroy the world. Consequently, the imperial court establishes the "Demon Suppression Command," a special agency dedicated to investigating such events...

description.en: A curious girl picks up an injured rabbit and takes it home. She goes out for a bit, but when she come backs, the rabbit has become a tall man and acts particularly viciously! That's the story of the weird relationship between a teenager and an elf.
description.vi: Một cô gái nhỏ tò mò nhặt một con thỏ bị thương và mang nó về nhà. Cô ấy đi ra ngoài một chút, nhưng khi cô ấy quay lại, con thỏ đã trở thành một cậu thiếu niên cao lớn và hành động đặc biệt hung ác! Đó là câu chuyện về mối quan hệ kỳ lạ giữa một cô gái nhỏ và một yêu tinh.

description.en: Ministry of Rites met poor student Zhang Ping by chance. Seeing a talented person being so broke, he sent him in the office, and let him begin investigations. Look at an ordinary person rising in his career and being worshiped.

Lu Wen, an 18-tier actor, has all of the looks but none of the EQ, and has talent in acting but none in foresight. On the first day upon entering filming cast, Lu Wen managed to offend the big-shot screenwriter: Qu Yanting.

 “But it wasn’t like it was on purpose.”

Later, he thought that Qu Yanting had some sort of personal grudge against him, using his money, his name, and unspoken rules to destroy Lu Wen’s reputation.

“The entertainment industry really is dirty.”

After jumping between triumphs and setbacks, fighting hot-shot actors, speaking brashly, participating in humiliating TV programs, and abandoning the script during reality shows...

“I really like Mr. Qu.”

From starting off as an 18-tier actor to becoming blacklisted by the entire internet, to then becoming a great god, the idiot Lu Wen has finally become a superstar celebrity.

“Big thanks to Mr. Qu for not abandoning me!”

At the same time, Mu Ya, a female elite soldier, was urgently transferred back from the front line…a battlefield story about "change" began.

Prince Yong, who was aiming for the country, replaced his recently born daughter with a boy from Old Chen Ge's place. More than ten years later, Chen family’s blue-blooded Miss Jiu grew up and learned martial arts, then entered a romantic entanglement with the scholarly young master of Jiang family, and Prince Bao who was out on an imperial patrol. One is a wanted anti-Qing handsome scholar who wants to restore the Ming dynasty, and the other is an extraordinary brilliant heir to the throne. Who should Miss Jiu pick?

Tactical Commander (White Lion Alpha) x Top Tier Beautiful Combat Force Assaulter (High Class Merman Omega).
Both of them were once test subjects of a research lab, depending and at the same time using each other for their own "benefits". However, because of a misunderstanding, White Lion was injured by Merman. He keeps saying that he'll get revenge against him, but when they met again,  he can't seem to do it. Instead, he can't help but protect his little merman...

Xia Cheng, Think about it … It is a very important thing." He had to go to the hospital for treatment and wanted to rely on drugs to escape the voice in his mind, but then he bumped into Shen Lin, a high-rank student from the same school that has haunted him like a ghost and couldn't get rid of it-maybe he is the real "drug" to Xiacheng.

Unfortunately, the Immortal clan/race is in decline in this world, and their situation is worse than that of dogs. As a collection fetishist, no matter what exotic treasures, celestial palace, or heavenly fairies, I want them all!!
description.zh: 游戏攻略up主鸥哥穿越修仙世界，开局就是天帝转世＋仙族至尊。可惜这个世界仙族没落，神仙不如落水狗，成就复兴大业，全靠鸥哥带飞。作为一个重度收集癖患者，什么奇珍异宝、瑶池天宫，还要养成仙子？！鸥哥表示，我全都要！

description.en:
Elisa wakes up from a long dream, her memories of the present blurry and unclear. Determined to find her memories, the witch goes to a human city.
But why?—Why are so many people suddenly gathering around me? Was my true identity discovered? Not knowing where to go, and not knowing who she really is, can the amnesiac jade witch manage to find her lost memories, and the truth behind her existence?


---

While on the way home from picking up groceries, she runs into a pretty boy, and that’s where our story begins. Will she find love in high school? And more importantly, will any boy be able to overlook the fact that although she is in high school, she still looks like an elementary student?? Follow along on Tong Danwei’s adventure of love and high school angst, with plenty of comedy thrown in to the mix.

All guests present took strong interest in this star of the police force and talked about him. What everyone didn’t know was, Wu Suowei himself was drinking beer in silence alongside Bai Yimeng. After leaving Lu Tianqi and finding his way through living alone in the dark, Xu Lingxin thought he was already used to being by himself. So why does Lu Tianqi seem unwilling to let go, as if trying to get him back? Meanwhile, his physician, Dr. Qin, wants to take this chance to get closer... Intending to kidnap the beauty, the two became acquainted. However, Chu Xi had always refused to surrender to fate and certainly didn’t plan on just going with the flow. What was the point of becoming a princess consort or empress? Doesn't opening her own harem sound better?

description.en:
The popular Idol group "X Girl" is going to perform at a live venue and fans are eagerly awaiting their appearance. 
But this time, the three beautiful sexy idols are high up in the sky on a secret mission, so they descend upon the concert venue with their airplane's cockpit damaged.
Danger? What I see is the buried truth! order? What I saw is the biggest lie in the world! ignorance? What I am looking for are the traces of memory!

I originally just went to the rooftop to ponder my amazing future plans. Would I save the world? Would I fight crime? Fate decided neither was happening.

It took less than 5 seconds to fall from the 25th floor to the ground and I suddenly reviewed my entire life and put together missing pieces that I never thought I would find. The will to live only gets stronger the more of this puzzle I piece together.

description.en: Shiqi is a young, strong-willed girl who collects scraps for a living. After provoking her fellow scrap collectors, they conspired against her and assaulted her at the waste disposal site. Unexpectedly, not only did she survive the ordeal, she even picked up a handsome man who was laying comatose when she came to. She then decides to bring him home out of goodwill. However, when the man woke up, he proclaimed himself to be a “god”?!
description.fr:
Shiqi, une fille dure qui ramasse les ordures.  
Laissée pour morte dans une déchetterie par des malfrats voulant se venger, elle se réveille devant

Elle le ramène gentiment chez lui, quand il lui dit qu'il est un dieu ?

description.en: During the years of the break of dawn, mankind had to rebuild from nothing, spending a long time in order to recover society’s economic crisis, at the same time many dojo started sprouting out of no where similarly to how grasses grow after rainy seasons. To the tens of thousands of citizen that reside within the city of Zhong Hai, the most important thing is the annual boxing tournament. Becoming the champion is every youth’s ultimate dream.
description.zh: 黄昏元年，人类几乎从废墟上重建，耗费很长的时间逐渐恢复社会经济秩序，各地的拳馆如雨后春笋一般冒了出来。对中海市这个拥有千万人口的大城市来说，最重要的拳赛莫过于一年一次的少师联盟赛。而冠军，是每个青年拳师的终极梦想。

description.en:
Curiosity led Luo Wei to explore the forbidden cave on his school grounds. There, he discovered a pair of mysterious twins fleeing a plague. Little did he know that the cave is a portal to another world — things are not as simple as the twins make them out to be…  
  
*There is no twincest in this.  
  
Please read from left to right.

[Yuri/Some parts 18+]

description.en: Only after you're friends with someone you like, do you realize that a confession is something that requires courage. Compared to having you, I'm more afraid of losing you. So in this lesson of loving you, I can only be an underachieving student.

God Killer Li, Devil Executioner Wang and Angel Slayer Liu could never even dream about a reunion at Judgement Primary School. Can they turn the tide against the Demon God, Zhao the Heaven Fucker in Year 4, to change the cursed fate?

description.en:
During high school, the wild Xiao Kaikai liked the tricky teacher, Xu Moran. But on the day that she was going to confess, Xu Moran disappeared without a trace. Six years later, Xiao Kaikai made her dream of becoming a pilots' instructor come true. And the Xu Moran who had disappeared six years ago reappeared and started to crazily pursue Xiao Kaikai.  
  
If you liked me, then why did you disappear at that time? If you don't like me then why did you come back to pursue me?  
  
All the mysteries surrounding Xu Moran get revealed one by one…

description.en:
Jefferey Ryan had had a troubled childhood: he never knew his father, and his mother died when he was seven. Years later, Fate made up to him with a loving wife and a beautiful daughter, and he was happy at last.   
But the rain that was falling that night when Jeffrey discovered his mother's bloody corpse seemed to never stop, and haunted him still….

In ancient times, a vile dragon summoned a flood that drowned the village. Since then, every year, the villagers would sacrifice a bride to the dragon for it to eat, doing so ensured the safety and peace of the village. This year, it is the Black Dragon YanMing’s turn to take the sacrificed bride, however he takes no interest in humans and would rather live on a diet of fruits. But, due to the constant nagging of the housekeeper, magpie XiQue, he had no choice but to go to the village and receive the bride offered by the village. YanMing, who was originally against the idea of going, couldn’t help but notice that the “mute” bride was so strange! She wasn’t afraid of him, but instead, very excited?! Whatever…let's capture her first!

description.en: Have you heard of a world of quick transmigration, bound by a prodigal system, where you'll die if you don't spend money? The embarrassing missions involve spending money, taking revenge, and ensuring the well-being of a pretty boy. Chuzheng had no choice but to accept these terms... the system is way too powerful. She can only advise everyone: if you want to become a big boss, start by spending money!
description.fr:
vez-vous entendu parler d'un monde de transmigration rapide, lié par un système de prodigalité, où vous mourrez si vous ne dépensez pas d'argent ? 
Les missions embarrassantes consistent à dépenser de l'argent, à se venger et à assurer le bien-être d'un joli garçon. 
Chu Zheng n'a pas eu d'autre choix que d'accepter ces conditions... le système est bien trop puissant. 
Elle ne peut que conseiller à tout le monde : si vous voulez devenir un big boss, commencez par dépenser de l'argent !

Lors de la conquête des Turbans jaunes, un garde forestier du comté de Zhuo a accidentellement acquis le Sceau d'or, un héritage de ses ancêtres de la dynastie Han, et s'est mis en route pour défendre sa famille et construire la dynastie Shu Han.

Playing Dumb Sterella Brother vs Beautiful, Strong, Miserable White Dragon Brother. Top Omegan white dragon Shou Yue killed the mafia boss, Si Xian, but saved his only son -- Si Mojue, and raised him like a younger brother. Unbeknownst to him, Si Mojue was an Alpha Sterella, only playing the part of a nice brother in front of Shou Yue, doing his best to become the person closest to him to avenge his father's death... An avenger, a murderer, and when the secret is revealed, what will they do?

description.en: She was forced to sell her body to save her ill mother. In the end, she still lost her mom. Just when she was immersed in grief and pain, she discovered that she was accidentally pregnant. She had to work in the entertainment industry to survive but she ran into the father of her child…who is the CEO of the company?!

A 21st century top-class assassin travels back in time one day to find that she's been transformed into the Second Miss of the Duanmu Family, one of the five great aristocratic families of the Xuanyuan Dynasty. But, this Second Miss was naturally useless, obsessed with men and a mother out of wedlock! Fine, since she was there already, then she should live coolly. When she appeared in front of everyone with her genius son, she was no longer "her". She wandered Jianghu with her son, killing everyone that got in the way. How would she survive in this chaotic world? And, out of all the handsome men that followed by her side, which one was her child's father? Finally, who would win her heart?

altTitles.zh: 热衷初拥美少女的德古拉子爵

description.en: Bucky Dracula — the young heir to the vampire clan — wished to have the world's prettiest girl as his First Embrace! He thought he could finally fulfil his dream when he was exiled to the east. Nevertheless, never did he expect to encounter so many of them: wight, werewolf, exorcist, fox demon... "Arghh! An innocent vampire like me can only have a girl of destiny!"

After completing an Escape Room mission, Tao Zijin discovered that his soul had accidentally entered the body of Wang Runzhi, the sister-in-law of poet Su Dongpo. Guided by a Fox Fairy, he was told that the only way for him to go home was by marrying Su Dongpo and fulfilling his duty as a wife. Now, Tao Zijin has to give his all to complete the mission of marrying Su Dongpo so he could go back to the real world.In this story, the body of a beautiful woman (Wang Runzhi) was combined with the heart of a modern geek (Tao Zijin); He was now a she. She, along with some famous people from history, Wang Anshi, Sima Guang, and Foyin, were now caught up in some intriguing emotional entanglements...

title.en: Our Young Master's Plans Are Infallible

description.en: Jiang Qiu was trying to climb over a school wall to skip class when he fell and killed himself! A moment later he awakes and finds that he has transmigrated into the Daxu Dynasty as a young master of the Jiang family. His biological mother passed away when he was young while his stepmother and brother do whatever they please in the house. In order to escape his stepmother and brother's evil schemes, and to prove his own worth, he decides to work hard and forge his own path toward the peak of life. One day, he will become a winner of life itself...

A loser named Qi Yue ran away to Tibet after he beat up a guy who stole his girlfriend. He was drawn to a temple where he meets a monk who says that he has the bloodline of the Ink Qilin. With his brash attitude and perverted ways, will he fulfill his duty as King of the Zodiacs?

title.en: Ao Bai Reincarnated in Another World

description.en: After giving it his all in a fierce battle against Li Yuanba in the arena, Ao Bai’s consciousness is unexpectedly summoned to another world. Goblins, orcs, wyverns, and other magical creatures await. Facing completely unfamiliar enemies, how will Ao Bai respond?

After his homeland was destroyed by cultists, the demon hunter Dante embarks on a path of revenge and redemption. Meanwhile, a forbidden power surges in the shadows within the empire. Regrets of the past and the suffering of the future must be confronted with human reason and courage in the face of boundless madness and insanity. In this world, there are no heroes comparable to gods—only ordinary people who step forward to face the abyss.

description.en: This year the cultivation realm isn't having much of a good time, either. Everyone's under a ton of pressure; A bit of bipolar over here, a little pre-ascention anxiety over there, even the elders are going schitzophrenic due to all the intense training! A modern psychologist gets transmigrated to the most depressing of all sects into the body of Xun Cai, the senior disciple whose body yin and yang are all sorts of 'wrong', and begins to treat the OCD Brother Lin Cong and his fellow disciples. And so, filled with love, the daily life of a chilled out cultivator begins!

description.zh: 我龙昊天，穿越后居然拥有了七个各色各样的老婆？看似很幸福的世界，这些美艳老婆却一个个都想要我的命！但是！那又怎样！任你什么母老虎，都要喵喵跪下叫老公！

She thought that she could live happily after she was adopted by the Ning Family, but who knew that her adopted parents and sister would abuse her. Even more, her tragic fate didn’t end there. Her adopted father gave her off to a client to be his mistress for his company profits. Thankfully, she encountered S.N. 's chairman, Gu Mingyan. He was a domineering and arrogant man. Though he was indifferent on the surface, he protected her silently...

After transmigration, time traveler Chen Yu found himself in a martial-domineering world, where he was deemed by “the will of the world” an illegal intruder and cursed with a state of reverse causality! While others ate to satisfy their hunger, Chen Yu suffered from starvation when he did. But wait, in this dog-eat-dog marital-domineering world, doesn’t it mean that taking a heavy blow can help him increase his Qi Energy and HP?

Li Ran took the risk of being expelled from the Sect and wrote a love letter to his junior sister, but it was sent to the master by mistake!

An ordinary student coincidentally ran into a vampire, and somehow, they ended up being neighbors. Moreover, who knew that this coincidence would lead to even more mysterious stories! How would you know if people around you weren't really human?

description.en: Song Yao is a high school boy whose parents mysteriously disappeared four years ago. He cooks, cleans, provides for himself and lives alone, and yet he always has the strange feeling that someone is following him…

The two-faced elite x the bad-tempered mafia boss! Elite student He Chusan was kidnapped by the head of the Warrior Clan, Xia Liuyi?! When this kind-hearted and upright citizen, who isn't influenced by the bad environment he is in, meets the "Twin-Blade Blood Asura," who causes people to tremble in fear, it seems to be a situation of the lamb entering the tiger's den, yet the "lamb" keeps pursuing the "tiger" relentlessly?Hold on, why does this "lamb" seem to increasingly resemble a fox, and has manipulated the big cat into his trap..

Cheng Yi Nuo was badly framed by her sister. She did not want to give in to fate. She wanted to rely on her intelligence to be an entertainment reporter. She did not expect to shoot on the first mission to her boss?

"You and I have the same fate,so why did I come here? For you, also for the sake of myself." - After being falsified by a "bestie", I transmigrated into a supporting role in a novel whose name has the same pronunciation as my own. God has gave me a chance to restart again, so I must use it properly! Start by apologizing to anyone who has ever bullied by me.. bla bla bla! Why is there still a ruthless and treacherous minister in the center of the original work! Although, a brave dogs won't be afraid of suffering, fight!
description.zh: “我和你有着相同的命运，所以我才会来到这里吗？是为了你，也是为了我自己。”—被“闺蜜”伪造现场后穿到了名字谐音和自己自己一样的小说配角中，上天给自己重来一次的机会一定要好好把握住！首先要对曾经欺负过的人表示歉意..等，等等！为什么还有原著中心狠手辣的大奸臣啊！虽然但是，勇敢狗狗不怕苦难，冲呀！

Gege did not choose to stay in the castle, but to conquer this new world!

Consequently, the number of people seeking help from God dwindled which led to a gradual decline in heavenly power. Dissension ensued as the heavens sought to initiate another Zhuolu war…

The fiery, pure, and lively Lie Ruge is the heiress to the powerful Liehuo Pavilion. The murky events of nineteen years prior bring her into a storm, and three men are destined to enter Ruge's life – the proud and aloof Feng, the quiet and gentle Yu, and the elegant and graceful Xue – Wind, Jade, and Snow. Thus begins an entangling and thrilling story of love and hate.

title.en: I Rely on Technology to Cultivate Immortality

description.en:
Lin Ting is a low-level maintenance worker in a future world, specializing in the maintenance of bionic robots. He sometimes secretly assembles Bionic Robots without a qualification certificate to sell them illegally.
After helping a Villager customize his Robot, he didn’t expect that female robot Is the Wife of the leader of underworld, Boss Wang. After the incident was exposed, Boss of the underworld captured Lin Ting and As punishment They forced his consciousness into a female bionic body.

title.en: The Wolf Is Fierce and Cautious

description.en:
Famous psychologist Zhao Yiming, was unexpectedly pulled into a mysterious game world to complete horrifying tasks, but has become a terrifying existence that makes all ghosts tremble in fear! 

Zhao Yiming: 'I'm just a bit cautious, that's all.' 

Domestic Violence Ghost: 'I was just going to the hospital for an appendectomy, but when I came out, only my appendix was left.' 

Crybaby Ghost: 'I was about to assign a side quest, and he chopped off my head!'
description.zh: 【日更】著名心理医生赵一明明是被拉入诡异游戏世界去完成恐怖任务，却成为了让所有鬼怪都瑟瑟发抖的存在！赵一：“我只是比较谨慎罢了。”家暴鬼：我只是去医院切个阑尾，结果出来只剩阑尾了。爱哭鬼：我刚想颁布个...

title.en: Resurrection of Reiki – Awakening of the God-Slaying Eye

altTitles.zh: 灵气复苏：开局觉醒弑天神眼

description.en: The sky is struck by the eagle, the dragon gate is leaped over by the fish, the bear roars and the tiger howls, indicating that all things possess spirits. The world has undergone a complete transformation with the pole of doom, the magnetic pole’s rotation, and global changes. The world that was once familiar has altered beyond recognition. The boundaries of the world are limitless, and the blood is eternal when myths turn into reality, and legends are no longer enigmatic.
description.id: Langit disambar elang, gerbang naga dilompati ikan, beruang mengaum dan harimau melolong, menandakan bahwa segala sesuatu memiliki roh. Dunia telah mengalami transformasi lengkap dengan kutub kiamat, rotasi kutub magnet, dan perubahan global. Dunia yang dulunya akrab telah berubah tanpa bisa dikenali. Batasan dunia tidak terbatas, dan darah abadi ketika mitos berubah menjadi kenyataan, dan legenda tidak lagi membingungkan.
description.zh: 鹰击长空，鱼跃龙门，熊咆虎啸，万物皆有灵。末法之极，磁极轮转，世界变迁。曾经那个熟悉的世界，已经变得面目全非。 当神话变成现实，当传说不再神秘，世界无疆，热血永恒。

description.en: In the flashy entertainment industry, drama and rumors explode on the daily, inciting public opinion. Behind the battle for public opinion, backstage players use sharp strategies to reverse and subvert situations. These players are called PR Crisis Agents! The female lead Zuo Bing is one of the best PR Agents in the world. During befuddling situations, she can always hunt down the lying “wolf” and reverse the situation. She’s gone through hundreds of these PR battles. But, on one fated PR battle, she met an opponent that toppled her from her throne…
description.zh: 光鲜的娱乐贵圈，每天都有舆论炸弹被引爆，而这些舆论战背后，藏着手法高明、能扭转局势的幕后玩家，他们被称为“危机公关”！女主左冰就是一位王牌公关，总能在扑朔迷离的案件中，迅速揪出那只撒谎的“狼”，将局势反转。

altTitles.en: The Return Of Emperor Ye Xuan

description.en: "**Before me array the soldiers, line up to fight**". This protection spell in traditional Chinese culture includes nine characters, each contains enormous energy of a different kind. With the power of the nine characters of truth, *Ye Xuan* is reborn from his fall. The power in the nine words was thus drained. In order to regain the power of revenge, *Ye Xuan* embarked on the road to reboot the nine characters of truth.
description.zh: 临、兵、斗、者、皆、阵、列、前、行，九字真言蕴育着九种不同的强大力量，借助九字真言之力，叶玄自陨灭之中复生，九字真言也因此损耗殆尽，为了重新找回力量复仇，叶玄踏上了修复九字真言之路。

description.en: After the immortal supreme Li Mu Xuan woke up after sleeping for a million years, he found that the world had changed drastically, and the core of the earth inside him used his immortal king’s body as a vessel; now, if he forcibly uses the immortal law, it is very likely to trigger a world-class disaster. In short, the current him is like being detained by the Earth.
description.zh: 沉睡百万年的仙王李牧玄苏醒后，发现世界大变样，体内的地球核心把他的仙王之躯当作容器，如今的他，若强行使用仙法，极有可能引发世界级灾难。总而言之，目前的他像是被地球给绑架了

description.en: The Fan clan, which possesses the ability to borrow powers from ghosts, had its succession ceremony interrupted by an accident. Everything began to spiral out of control...

With these eyes, he is able to see the afterimages of the people that have passed and rediscovering new treasures! with these eyes he is able to see through illusions! Now that I have crossed into this absurd world where the strong are respected, there is no reason for me, Lin Ling, to be bullied by you! the lost powerful martial arts are mine, the shining blossom beauties are mine, all the secret treasures are also mine! anyone that dares offend me will die… peacefully under my sword.

description.en: High school dropout Hank Yan has a lot of hobbies. Studying, live streaming his day to day, and beating up bullies as a hero vigilante?! One day, Hank saves a young man named Junior. Shy and suffering from a dark past of abuse, Junior is a lot like Hank. Both barely have parents, if they are alive at all, both are interested in one another. Is it luck that they met or…fate?    [Adapted from Wu Zhe's novel of the same name]
